newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oji Paper 1997/98 profit seen down sharply--paper.
newsitem.headline: Oji Paper 1997/98 profit seen down sharply--paper.

text.p: Oji Paper Co Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of 23 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, down sharply from its estimated profit for 1996/97, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday.
The company was not immediately available for comment on the report.
Oji said in October that its parent current profit in 1996/97 would be 48 billion yen, little changed from its actual parent current profit of 48.07 billion yen in 1995/96.
Nihon Keizai said it expected Oji's 1997/98 earnings would decline due to falling paper prices and increased depreciation costs related to new plant and equipment.
